{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Confirm removal
print(f"Number of QA orders removed: {len(df) - len(df_clean)}")
print(f"New total rows: {len(df_clean)}")

# Now, filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion fraction
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
converted_loyal = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
frac_converted = converted_loyal / n_loyal

print(f"Number of loyal customers: {n_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal customers: {converted_loyal}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {frac_converted}")"}
